qualitative.gate_2_reason: 100% of operations and revenues are concentrated in Sub-Saharan Africa (14 African nations) outside Western developed rule-of-law markets, exposed to severe currency devaluations and sovereign regulatory extraction.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Western Need). While providing essential telecom and mobile money services across 14 Sub-Saharan African countries, 100% of operations and revenue originate outside Western developed markets, suffering severe structural currency devaluations (e.g. Nigerian Naira) and high sovereign/regulatory risks.
qualitative.evidence: Airtel Africa operates across Nigeria, East Africa, and Francophone Africa. Severe FX devaluations (e.g. Nigerian Naira collapse in FY24) have repeatedly crushed USD/GBP reported profits and cash conversion despite local currency growth. Revenue base concentrated entirely in non-Western emerging markets violates Gate 2.
